Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we dispute claim R-0000068, which was taken on 2014-07-30. The amount in dispute is $98.56. According to our records, the correct spoils allowance for this store and period is $80.13 (0.0100 of $8,013.12 invoiced). Therefore, the amount to repay is $18.43. The dispute deadline was 2015-01-26, and this deadline has passed.

We hope to resolve this matter promptly. Please contact us at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,

Northfield Pantry Co.
